acceptance.evidence: migrations/0003_item_categories.sql matches the spec. test/index.test.js 'AC-1' checks the seed rows, UNIQUE and CHECK rejections, a nullable category_id, the index, and the tagged items.
test 'AC-2' inserts with title only (category_id is null) and expects a FOREIGN KEY error for category_id 999.
test 'AC-3' checks id order, the span markup, the bare <li> for an uncategorised item, and a 200 status. src/index.js produces that markup.
test 'AC-4' checks the link order with a lower-case 'errands' category, the hrefs, an empty category still linked, and only All current.
two 'AC-5' tests cover Work-only items in id order, the Work link current, and /?category=Work&x=1 and /?x=1 giving identical pages.
test 'AC-6' checks a 200 status, the 'No items in this category.' message, no <li>, and the category's link current.
test 'AC-7' checks the escaped label, the encoded href '/?category=R%26D%20%3Cx%3E', and that requesting that link lists the item.
it.each over all 5 broken URLs checks the 404, the message, the Go back href '/', the referrer script, and no <li> or <nav>.
test 'AC-9' checks HEAD returns 200, 200 and 404 for the three URLs.

Verified by review as the spec allows, by reading the script in brokenLinkPage. A same-origin referrer calls history.back(). An empty referrer makes new URL throw, so the plain href '/' is used. The extra history.length > 1 condition is harmless.

routes.json lists '/?category=Work'. tests/traffic-config.test.sh accepts a query route and rejects whitespace, a fragment and a missing slash. The traffic test checks ROUTES and that the fake app records path plus query. The index test checks that every listed route answers ok.
The existing tests are kept, with only the <li>First item> assertion updated as the spec allows. The healthz, 405, 404, escaping and 'No items yet.' behaviour is untouched in src/index.js.
test/apply-migrations.js drops all tables in one batch with defer_foreign_keys on. The 'AC-13' test adds a categorised row and expects the item count to be 4, which only holds if the reset ran.

findings.what: The States table says 'Go back' is hidden on the 200 rows, but no test asserts the 200 pages lack a 'Go back' link or the corrupted message.
findings.fix: Add expect(html).not.toContain('Go back') to the AC-3, AC-5 and AC-6 tests.

lenses.note: The change matches the spec's intent. No scope was added beyond the extra history.length guard in the Go back script.
